title: Book with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- book cover (back) -->
  <rect x='22' y='18' width='56' height='68' rx='5' fill='#c0392b'/>
  <!-- book pages (right edge, lighter) -->
  <rect x='70' y='20' width='8' height='64' rx='3' fill='#f7e9d0'/>
  <line x1='72' y1='24' x2='72' y2='80' stroke='#e0c9a6' stroke-width='2'/>
  <line x1='75' y1='24' x2='75' y2='80' stroke='#e0c9a6' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- book spine (left) -->
  <rect x='22' y='18' width='9' height='68' rx='5' fill='#8e2a20'/>
  <!-- front cover face panel (lighter shade, no dark outline) -->
  <rect x='33' y='26' width='40' height='52' rx='4' fill='#e74c3c'/>
  <!-- smiling face on the cover -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='44' r='4.5' fill='#fff3b0'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='44' r='4.5' fill='#fff3b0'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='45' r='2' fill='#b03a2e'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='45' r='2' fill='#b03a2e'/>
  <path d='M42 56 Q53 68 64 56' stroke='#fff3b0' stroke-width='4.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='53' r='3' fill='#f5a3a3' opacity='0.85'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='53' r='3' fill='#f5a3a3' opacity='0.85'/>
  <!-- bookmarks ribbon -->
  <rect x='52' y='84' width='7' height='12' fill='#f1c40f'/>
  <polygon points='52,96 55.5,92 59,96' fill='#f1c40f'/>
</svg>
